name: com.cidonix.unibridge
description: Local MCP tools that let AI coding agents inspect, edit, capture, and validate Unity Editor projects through a per-project bridge and relay.

_upm.changelog:
### Added

- Stable operation IDs and query-only command recovery with UniBridge_CommandStatus.
- Identity-scoped, bounded ten-minute Editor-session journal survives domain reloads; started writes and completed successes/errors are recorded before execution and delivery.
- Reproducible relay/journal fault tests and opt-in live qualification fixtures under Tools~/CommandReplayRegression.

### Fixed

- Relay 1.1.0-build.20 does not automatically repeat mutations, captures, mixed tools, or unknown commands after losing a response. Only whole-tool certified reads with replaySafe=true may be resubmitted in the same Editor session; custom tools default ReplaySafe=false and require explicit opt-in plus ReadOnly/Observer policy.
- Missing, interrupted, expired, oversized, unavailable, restarted-Editor, and legacy outcomes return outcome_unknown with a status-query suggestion when available.
- Lost BatchActions replies do not fabricate partial or whole-batch success. Pure reads use an in-memory duplicate cache without writing the durable mutation journal.
